flow cytometry.sample_type: heparinized whole blood or cryopreserved PBMCs
flow cytometry.readouts: frequencies and phenotypes of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, Tfh-like cells, innate cell populations, plasmablasts, NK cells, neutrophils, dendritic cells, activation markers (e.g., Ki67, Bcl2, CXCR5, ICOS, CXCR3, CD80, HLA-DR), intracellular VZV glycoprotein and cytokines

evidence_location.quote: Figure 1C shows an increase in CD4+CXCR5+CXCR3+ICOS+ T cells after Zostavax® in both the young and elderly adults.

aliases: Zostavax®-specific IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 ELISPOT
Zostavax®-specific and total IgG B cell ELISPOT
ELISPOT.readouts: antigen-specific IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 spot-forming cells; VZV-specific plasmablast/IgG B cell spot counts

evidence_location.quote: Significant increase in CD4+ T cells that are positive for IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 were also detected, indicating a mixed Th1/Th2/Th21 profile (Figure 1C).

ELISA.readouts: VZV glycoprotein-specific IgG titers, VZV lysate-specific IgG titers, VZV-specific IgA titers

evidence_location.quote: The measurement of VZV glycoprotein-specific IgG over the course of the study showed significant increases induced by Zostavax® in both the young and elderly adults (Figure 1E).

PCR.readouts: VZV DNAemia / viral DNA copy numbers

evidence_location.quote: Interestingly, when we examined VZV DNA in the blood, although residual amount of viral DNA was seen in some subjects at day 1 (Table S2), only three showed positive viral replication in the blood, including both the CD8+ responders (Figure 1D).

Multiplex cytokine assays.readouts: cytokine concentrations (e.g., IL-7 and other plasma cytokines)

evidence_location.quote: Furthermore, difference in NK cells measured by flow cytometry (Figure 4E) was consistent with the transcriptomics data, and Luminex data supported the higher level of IL-7 in the elderly group (Figure 4F).

PBMC Transcriptomics analysis.readouts: gene expression / transcriptional signatures and blood transcription module activities

evidence_location.quote: We assessed the gene expression changes in PBMCs induced by Zostavax® vaccination.

PBMC Transcriptomics analysis.obi_label: transcript analysis by single-end sequencing assay

Plasma Metabolomics analysis.readouts: metabolite peaks, metabolomic signatures, pathway-associated metabolite changes

evidence_location.quote: Using untargeted high-resolution metabolomics, thousands of metabolite peaks were detected in vaccinee plasma samples (Figure 2A, B).

evidence_location.quote: However, Zostavax® induced several chemokines, such as CXCL8, CCL2, CXCL9 and CXCL10 in PBMCs (Figure S3E).
